title: FatPipe Constellation’s Approach to Network Change and Collaboration
summary: Rather than leaving customers to manage increasingly complex network enviro on their own, FatPipe helps connect tech functionality with practical application.
body_markdown:
Today’s networks are constantly evolving, making it essential to track changes, understand their impact, and communicate them clearly. While many vendors claim to address these operational and security needs,[FatPipe Constellation](https://www.fatpipeinc.com/products/fatpipe-constellation) provides intuitive workflows designed to support real-world NetOps and DevOps collaboration. FatPipe Constellation was developed through focused research and development in[network monitoring](https://www.fatpipeinc.com/products/enterprise-view) . Instead of simply alerting administrators that CPU usage is high, for example, Constellation provides additional context through supporting graphs. This helps administrators understand what is happening across the network, how individual components affect the broader environment, and where attention may be needed.


**Device Discovery: Where Understanding Network Changes Begins**


Device discovery is fundamental to understanding network changes. As new devices are introduced or existing devices are modified, administrators need a reliable way to maintain an accurate view of their environment.


Constellation’s tools for adding and updating discovered devices help keep monitored device information aligned with the network as it evolves.


These capabilities provide a broader benefit. Administrators can identify changes within the infrastructure they manage, assess their significance, and communicate relevant findings without relying entirely on manually maintained device records. As discussed in our earlier blog on network topology visualization, a current network map is useful. Understanding how the network has changed over time makes that map considerably more valuable.


**Alert Management: When Network Changes Need to Be Communicated**


Knowing that something has changed is one part of network management. Ensuring that the people responsible for the affected infrastructure receive the information they need is another.


FatPipe Constellation’s Alert Rules and Device Mapping capabilities allow administrators to define monitoring conditions and associate alert rules with the appropriate devices.


Email, SMS, and webhook notifications provide multiple ways to communicate monitored events. For example, administrators can configure an alert for a critical interface outage and use the appropriate notification channels to inform the responsible team.


Webhooks can also send events to compatible external systems based on the organization’s configured integrations.


**Beyond Network Monitoring: FatPipe as a Technology Partner**


[Constellation](https://www.fatpipeinc.com/products/fatpipe-constellation) makes network visibility, device discovery, performance monitoring, and alert management accessible to organizations seeking greater control over growing network environments. FatPipe complements these capabilities with customer education and technical support.


FatPipe’s website provides product information and resources to help organizations explore available capabilities. Product demonstrations and access to a dedicated support team also help customers understand how those capabilities may address their specific network requirements. Rather than leaving customers to manage increasingly complex network environments on their own, FatPipe helps connect technical functionality with practical application.
